decoDesc.text:
Very economic equipment, created according to ancient scrolls and books found in Qingbo Stockade.
A suit of heavy armor assembled using heavy metal slabs and bamboo strips soaked in special herbal juice. The people of Qingbo Stockade were extremely low on supplies and thus came up with this armor design.

desc.text: Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.

decoDesc.text:
Very economic equipment, created according to ancient scrolls and books found in Qingbo Stockade.
A suit of light armor assembled by weaving special bamboo strips with extremely resilient leather. Qingbo Stockade was surrounded by many wild creatures when it was first founded. Defensive gear made using beast hides was quite common back then.

desc.text: Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.

decoDesc.text: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all Accordatories shall, while ensuring the unimpeded circulation of Talosian Credit Notes in the civilian economy, maintain commodity stockpiles to cover the issuance of such stock bills, thereby facilitating orderly and effective joint stockpile redistribution under exceptional circumstances.

desc.text: Stock bills issued in Wuling and only usable in the said region. They have all sorts of uses.

description.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+{1-comboskill_cooldown:0%}</>.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{spell_up:0%}</> (for every skill) for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack} stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.
